title: juniperus phoenicea subsp. turbinata
intro: Juniperus phoenicea subsp. turbinata, commonly known as Eastern Red Cedar, is a species of evergreen tree native to the eastern United States. This plant has been traditionally used to support respiratory health, with benefits including relief from bronchitis, coughs, and congestion, due to its expectorant properties. The therapeutic actions of Eastern Red Cedar include anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial effects, attributed to its ability to inhibit the growth of bacteria and reduce inflammation. The bioactive constituents of this plant include essential oils, flavonoids, and terpenes, such as cedrol and thujaplicin, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
